_comment: Expected answers for a signed-out caller using the public app key. 'denied' = HTTP 401/403/404; 'empty' = HTTP 200 with no rows; 'data' = HTTP 200 with rows (control: proves the probes reach the API). Changing an expectation needs the CTO's review (CODEOWNERS).

probes.what: WhatsApp booking session without the server key
household dashboard by id without sign-in
collector earnings by id without sign-in

moneyWrites._comment: Phase 13 / TD54 (2026-11-12): tables with money or points columns that signed-in users can write, each reviewed: guarded by the server (bags, batches, bin_payments, collector_profiles, digital_bins, illegal_dumping_mobile, pickup_requests, profiles) or not read by any balance or payout (bag_orders, dumping_reports, reward_redemptions, user_activity; withdrawals need server-written items that add up). Adding a table here needs the owner's approval.

skippedCallerCheck._comment: Elevated (SECURITY DEFINER) functions anyone can call whose caller check runs only when someone is signed in. 0 since 20261112165513 (validate_cashout).

migrationLedger._comment: TD18 / ADR-001: every migration production has recorded must have its file in one of these folders. On 2026-11-12 all 55 did. Files applied by hand in the SQL editor before 2026-11-11 are not in production's history and are not checked here.

capacity._comment: TD20: database performance work (indexes, policy rewrites) waits until a table or the database is this big. Reported daily, never fails. On 2026-11-12 the largest table had about 1,100 rows and digital_bins 28.

logScan._comment: Signed-out callers that touch many tables in one minute, or ask for many tables that don't exist, are scanning the API. Measured 2026-11-11: real signed-out visitors touched at most 21 tables or functions a minute and got no 'not found' answers; one scan touched 150 and got 137 not-found answers in a minute. Needs SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN and SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF. Raising a limit needs the CTO's review (CODEOWNERS).

advisors._comment: Known ERROR-level advisor findings, accepted until tech-debt TD19 fixes them. A new ERROR finding fails the watch, and so does an entry here the advisor no longer reports: the list only shrinks. 2026-11-13: dumping_duplicate_monitoring, unified_pickup_status, urgent_digital_bins and user_dumping_activity removed (signed-in and signed-out users can no longer read them, so the advisor stopped reporting them).
advisors._ceilings_comment: Warning counts that may only go down. A count below its ceiling fails the watch until the ceiling is lowered to it, and a WARN-level type without a ceiling fails it too (reasons in _ceilingReasons). 2026-11-13: anon 35 -> 34; ceilings added for the other three warning types.

_ceilingReasons.anon_security_definer_function_executabl: TD19: mostly triggers (not callable through the API) and deliberate public lookups (sign-up phone check, invite links, pricing)
_ceilingReasons.authenticated_security_definer_function_: TD19: signed-in functions; each checks its caller (td_assert_self_or_staff and the access fingerprints below)
_ceilingReasons.extension_in_public: postgis and pg_net, installed there before 2026; moving postgis would touch the tables whose columns use its types, and pg_net must be dropped and recreated. Accepted, 2026-11-13
_ceilingReasons.vulnerable_postgres_version: TD62: Postgres 15.8 has security patches waiting; the owner runs the upgrade from the Supabase dashboard

_writePolicies_comment: Row-level security write policies (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or ALL) that apply to every row (USING/WITH CHECK true) or to signed-out visitors (anon). Policies made in the dashboard never pass the migration check, so the live database is counted daily. Only the count is published (the repository is public); list them with the query in engineering/runbooks/database-function-review.md. Policies for service_role alone are not counted (that key bypasses row-level security anyway). maxOpen was 9 on 2026-11-12 and is 0 since TD50 closed them the same day; never raise it without the CTO.
_protectedDefinitions_comment: Fingerprints (md5 of definition and grants) of the database objects that hold the owner's protected rules: digital bin pricing (docs/DIGITAL_BIN_PRICING.md), points (docs/POINTS.md) and collector payouts (docs/COLLECTOR_PAYOUTS.md). Recorded 2026-11-12 ; 24 objects after td_keep_booked_payout (20261112113921) and the server-side collector share (20261112120016), both owner approved the same day. A difference fails the watch: either someone changed a protected rule outside an approved pull request, or an approved change forgot to record its new fingerprint. Update a value only in the pull request that carries the owner's written approval (engineering/runbooks/protected-rules.md).
_accessDefinitions_comment: Fingerprints of the functions and row-level policies that decide what an account can see and do (roles, areas, volunteer teams, staff, capabilities). Recorded 2026-11-13 after the TD61 fix (20261113104611) and a review of every function that writes the access tables. A change fails the watch until it has been reviewed in a pull request (can an account give itself more access?) and its new fingerprint recorded: engineering/runbooks/database-function-review.md, Access control. Stored as "md5:<hash>" so the secret scan does not mistake them for API keys (names like my_access).
_uncheckedFunctions_comment: Database functions that run with their owner's rights, can be run by any signed-in user and show no check of who is calling: those that write and take an id, and those that read personal data (auth.users, phone numbers). Baseline 2026-11-12 after TD19 round 3 (20261112122021): 0 writers; 2 readers, both deliberate yes/no answers (the sign-up phone check, is_active_collector). Only counts are published; never raise a baseline without the CTO.
_personalExposure_comment: Tables without row-level security, materialized views and views that run as their owner, readable by signed-out callers, that hold personal columns (email, phone, names, MoMo numbers, addresses). 0 since 2026-11-12 (20261112124531 closed user_stats_aggregated). Count only; never raise without the CTO.

ownedDomains._comment: TD58: bin QR links not on app.trashdrops.com, accounts able to sign in with an email on an unowned TrashDrop domain, functions naming one. 0 since 20261112231231.
